Exploration

Use the controls to sketch hypothetical changes to the three diagrams on the project page. These are interactive teaching visuals, not observed flight records or forecasts. Select a seasonal cell and enter a value, drag airports to rearrange the route sketch, or enter operational values to update the flow diagram.

Seasonal pattern sketch

Choose a month and measure, then enter a hypothetical value. Click or drag across the grid to select a cell.

Each cell is an illustrative index from 0 to 100. Editing one cell changes only this sketch.

Draggable route sketch

Drag any airport node. Enter a hypothetical route distance and daily flight count to change the highlighted link.

This schematic has no geographic scale. Dragging nodes changes the drawing only, not real airport coordinates.

Operational outcome sketch

Enter hypothetical delay minutes and cancellation percentage to change the relative bars.

Bars are scaled to the input ranges, not to an empirical flight dataset.
